results.question: How many invoices were issued in 2010?

FROM Employee

results.question: How many playlists are there?

results.question: What is the total of all invoice totals?

results.question: Which genre has the most tracks?
results.sql:
SELECT 
    g.Name
FROM 
    Genre g
JOIN 
    Track t ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId
GROUP BY 
    g.GenreId, g.Name
ORDER BY 
    COUNT(t.TrackId) DESC
LIMIT 1

results.question: How many albums does AC/DC have?
results.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM Album a
JOIN Artist ar ON a.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId
WHERE ar.Name = 'AC/DC'

results.question: Which 5 countries have the most customers?
results.sql:
SELECT 
    Country,
    COUNT(*) AS CustomerCount
FROM 
    Customer
GROUP BY 
    Country
ORDER BY 
    CustomerCount DESC
LIMIT 5

results.question: What are the top 5 customers by total invoice amount? Give their full names.
results.sql:
SELECT 
    c.FirstName,
    c.LastName
FROM Customer c
JOIN Invoice i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId
GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName
ORDER BY SUM(i.Total) DESC
LIMIT 5

results.question: Which artist has the most albums?
results.sql:
SELECT a.Name
FROM Artist a
JOIN Album al ON a.ArtistId = al.ArtistId
GROUP BY a.ArtistId, a.Name
ORDER BY COUNT(al.AlbumId) DESC
LIMIT 1

results.question: What was the total invoice amount per year?
results.sql:
SELECT 
    strftime('%Y', Invoice.InvoiceDate) AS Year,
    SUM(Invoice.Total) AS TotalInvoiceAmount
FROM 
    Invoice
GROUP BY 
    strftime('%Y', Invoice.InvoiceDate)
ORDER BY 
    Year

results.question: How many tracks are longer than 5 minutes?
results.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS TrackCount
FROM Track
WHERE Milliseconds > 300000

results.question: Which album has the most tracks?
results.sql:
SELECT 
    a.Title
FROM 
    Album a
JOIN 
    Track t ON a.AlbumId = t.AlbumId
GROUP BY 
    a.AlbumId, a.Title
ORDER BY 
    COUNT(t.TrackId) DESC

results.question: Which employee is the support rep for the most customers? Give their full name.
results.sql:
SELECT 
    e.FirstName || ' ' || e.LastName AS FullName
FROM Customer c
JOIN Employee e ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId
GROUP BY c.SupportRepId, e.FirstName, e.LastName
ORDER BY COUNT(c.CustomerId) DESC
LIMIT 1

results.question: Which billing country had the highest total invoice amount?
results.sql:
SELECT 
    i.BillingCountry
FROM 
    Invoice i
GROUP BY 
    i.BillingCountry
ORDER BY 
    SUM(i.Total) DESC
LIMIT 1

results.question: Which artist generated the most revenue from track sales?
results.sql:
SELECT 
    a.Name
FROM 
    Artist a
JOIN 
    Album al ON a.ArtistId = al.ArtistId
JOIN 
    Track t ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId
JOIN 
    InvoiceLine il ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId
GROUP BY 
    a.ArtistId, a.Name
ORDER BY 
    SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) DESC
LIMIT 1

results.question: What are the top 3 genres by revenue?
results.sql:
SELECT 
    g.Name AS Genre,
    SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) AS Revenue
FROM Genre g
JOIN Track t ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId
JOIN InvoiceLine il ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId
GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name
ORDER BY Revenue DESC
LIMIT 3

results.question: Which sales support agent's customers generated the most invoice revenue? Give the agent's full name.
results.sql:
SELECT 
    e.FirstName || ' ' || e.LastName AS Full_Name
FROM 
    Employee e
JOIN 
    Customer c ON e.EmployeeId = c.SupportRepId
JOIN 
    Invoice i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId
JOIN 
    InvoiceLine il ON i.InvoiceId = il.InvoiceId
GROUP BY 
    e.EmployeeId, e.FirstName, e.LastName
ORDER BY 
    SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) DESC
LIMIT 1

results.question: How many tracks have never been purchased?
results.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM Track t
LEFT JOIN InvoiceLine il ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId
WHERE il.InvoiceLineId IS NULL

results.question: What percentage of tracks are longer than 5 minutes? Round to one decimal place.
results.sql:
SELECT 
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Milliseconds > 300000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 
        1
    ) AS percentage
FROM Track

results.question: Which customer spent the most in 2013? Give their full name.
results.sql:

FROM

JOIN

results.question: Who does Steve Johnson report to? Give the manager's full name.
results.sql:

    e2.FirstName || ' ' || e2.LastName AS ManagerFullName
FROM 
    Employee e1
JOIN

results.question: How many distinct customers bought at least one Jazz track?
results.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i.CustomerId)
FROM Invoice i
JOIN InvoiceLine il ON i.InvoiceId = il.InvoiceId
JOIN Track t ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId
JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId
WHERE g.Name = 'Jazz'

results.question: Which month of 2012 had the highest invoice total? Answer with the month number.
results.sql:
SELECT 
    CAST(strftime('%m', InvoiceDate) AS INTEGER) AS MonthNumber
FROM 
    Invoice
WHERE 
    strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) = '2012'
GROUP BY 
    strftime('%m', InvoiceDate)
ORDER BY 
    SUM(Total) DESC
LIMIT 1

results.question: By what percentage did total invoice revenue grow from 2009 to 2010? Round to one decimal place.
results.sql:
WITH yearly_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        strftime('%Y', Invoice.InvoiceDate) AS year,
        SUM(InvoiceLine.UnitPrice * InvoiceLine.Quantity) AS revenue
    FROM Invoice
    JOIN InvoiceLine ON Invoice.InvoiceId = InvoiceLine.InvoiceId
    WHERE strftime('%Y', Invoice.InvoiceDate) IN ('2009', '2010')
    GROUP BY strftime('%Y', Invoice.InvoiceDate)
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(
        (
            (SELECT revenue FROM yearly_revenue WHERE year = '2010') - 
            (SELECT revenue FROM yearly_revenue WHERE year = '2009')
        ) * 100.0 / 
        (SELECT revenue FROM yearly_revenue WHERE year = '2009'),
        1
    ) AS percentage_growth
FROM yearly_revenue
LIMIT 1

results.question: How many employees report to Andrew Adams, directly or indirectly?
results.sql:
WITH RECURSIVE ReportingHierarchy AS (
    -- Base case: Employees who directly report to Andrew Adams
    SELECT EmployeeId
    FROM Employee
    WHERE ReportsTo = (
        SELECT EmployeeId 
        FROM Employee 
        WHERE FirstName = 'Andrew' AND LastName = 'Adams'
    )
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: Employees who report to anyone in the hierarchy
    SELECT e.EmployeeId
    FROM Employee e
    INNER JOIN ReportingHierarchy rh ON e.ReportsTo = rh.EmployeeId
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS EmployeeCount
FROM ReportingHierarchy

results.question: For each year, which billing country had the second-highest invoice total? Give the year and country.
results.sql:
WITH YearlyCountryTotals AS (
    SELECT
        strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) AS Year,
        BillingCountry,
        SUM(Total) AS TotalRevenue
    FROM Invoice
    GROUP BY strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate), BillingCountry
),
RankedCountries AS (
    SELECT
        Year,
        BillingCountry,
        TotalRevenue,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY Year ORDER BY TotalRevenue DESC) AS Rank
    FROM YearlyCountryTotals
)
SELECT
    Year,
    BillingCountry
FROM RankedCountries
WHERE Rank = 2
ORDER BY Year

results.question: How many customers have bought tracks from at least 10 different genres?
results.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i.CustomerId) AS CustomerCount
FROM Invoice i
JOIN InvoiceLine il ON i.InvoiceId = il.InvoiceId
JOIN Track t ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId
WHERE t.GenreId IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY i.CustomerId
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.GenreId) >= 10

results.question: How many artists have tracks in more than one genre?
results.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.ArtistId)
FROM Artist a
JOIN Album al ON a.ArtistId = al.ArtistId
JOIN Track t ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId
GROUP BY a.ArtistId
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.GenreId) > 1

results.question: Which calendar month had the highest invoice total across the whole history? Answer as YYYY-MM.
results.sql:
SELECT 
    strftime('%Y-%m', InvoiceDate) AS YearMonth
FROM 
    Invoice
GROUP BY 
    strftime('%Y-%m', InvoiceDate)
ORDER BY 
    SUM(Total) DESC
LIMIT 1

results.question: Which genre had the second-highest number of tracks sold to customers billed in the USA?
results.sql:
WITH GenreSales AS (
    SELECT 
        g.Name AS GenreName,
        COUNT(*) AS TrackCount
    FROM InvoiceLine il
    JOIN Invoice i ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId
    JOIN Track t ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId
    JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId
    WHERE i.BillingCountry = 'USA'
    GROUP BY g.Name
),
RankedGenres AS (
    SELECT 
        GenreName,
        TrackCount,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY TrackCount DESC) AS Rank
    FROM GenreSales
)
SELECT GenreName
FROM RankedGenres
WHERE Rank = 2
LIMIT 1

results.question: Which customers made purchases in every year from 2009 to 2013 and spent more than $45 in total? Give full names.
results.sql:
WITH CustomerYears AS (
    SELECT 
        i.CustomerId,
        strftime('%Y', i.InvoiceDate) AS Year,
        SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) AS YearlySpend
    FROM Invoice i
    JOIN InvoiceLine il ON i.InvoiceId = il.InvoiceId
    WHERE strftime('%Y', i.InvoiceDate) BETWEEN '2009' AND '2013'
    GROUP BY i.CustomerId, strftime('%Y', i.InvoiceDate)
),
CustomerTotals AS (
    SELECT 
        CustomerId,
        COUNT(DISTINCT Year) AS YearsPurchased,
        SUM(YearlySpend) AS TotalSpend
    FROM CustomerYears
    GROUP BY CustomerId
)
SELECT 
    c.FirstName || ' ' || c.LastName AS FullName
FROM Customer c
JOIN CustomerTotals ct ON c.CustomerId = ct.CustomerId
WHERE ct.YearsPurchased = 5
  AND ct.TotalSpend > 45

results.question: What percentage of track-sales revenue came from video tracks (media types containing 'video')? Round to one decimal place.
results.sql:
SELECT 
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN mt.Name LIKE '%video%' THEN il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity ELSE 0 END) / 
        SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity), 
    1) AS percentage
FROM InvoiceLine il
JOIN Track t ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId
JOIN MediaType mt ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId

results.question: How many customers made no purchases in 2013?
results.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM Customer c
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 
    FROM Invoice i 
    WHERE i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId 
      AND strftime('%Y', i.InvoiceDate) = '2013'
)
